answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 36246 Country: India Title: I am working in air travel agency on salary basis, but I get some customers who are my friends, some known persons, neighbour etc Question: I am working in air travel agency on salary basis, but I get some customers who are my friends, some known persons, neighbour etc who buy tickets on cash basis, I get discount from our agency but I keep that discount without giving to them. Can I keep this commission? Is it allowed for me? Is it haram or halal? Please advice. Answer ID: 36246 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 162/162/M=1433) The discount that the agency provides on buying cash ticket if it is for the person who is buying the ticket then it is a treachery to keep it with you without their permission. It is not lawful to do so, that amount is lawful for you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
